source_en: Closed the corner grocery. Going home.
Shop sold out by noon. Home.
Dropping register keys at the manager's.
Home to my wife and kids.
Collecting my pension. Retired last year.
Hosting a block party tonight. Can't wait!
Here’s my ID and the form. Filled them out in the bread line.
Is your stamp working? Everything else in this city seems to be broken.
Cool. Have a fun time in your little box, officer.
A holding cell? Does it have a bed? I could use a nap.
Sure. Lock me up. Add it to the list of things that don’t matter.
Hm. Didn’t even need to think about it, did you.
Finally… I can stop… waiting… in lines…
Where are you coming from?
The shop. Sold out by noon. I stood in the bread line anyway.
The shop on the western block. Been working there a few months.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
No. Tired. I'm always tired. That's not new, officer.
Never tired. I sleep ten hours a night. The shop's always full.
No bread again. I stood in line an hour anyway. Force of habit.
You look like you are about to ask me something. Please do not.
